capabilities.text: Draw the top view
capabilities.note: The opening state; the token shows the switch that reaches it is live.

capabilities.text: Draw a vertical circle
Draw a conical pendulum
capabilities.note: Ours has Top view and Vertical circle only.

capabilities.text: In the top view, put a string around the object
In the top view, put the object on a turntable
In the top view, put the object on a road
Draw the object at 1 to 8 positions
capabilities.note: Ours draws one position in the top view.

capabilities.text: Set where the first position is
Go round clockwise or counterclockwise
capabilities.note: Ours’ direction switch applies only to the vertical circle; the top view always goes counterclockwise.

capabilities.text: Add a second object halfway out on a turntable, with a velocity arrow half as long
Swing the object in a vertical circle on a string
capabilities.note: Ours’ vertical circle is on a string (tension).

capabilities.text: Run the vertical circle as a loop
Put the object over a hill
Put the object in a dip
Put the object at the top, the bottom, or both
capabilities.note: Token passes on the setup alone; checked by hand that Top differs from Top and bottom.

capabilities.text: Put the object at the side of the vertical circle
capabilities.note: Ours has Top, Bottom, Top and bottom only.

capabilities.text: Set the conical pendulum’s string angle from the vertical, 15° to 60°
Label the conical pendulum’s angle and string length
Draw the conical pendulum’s velocity into or out of the page
Turn each vector on or off (velocity, centripetal acceleration, inward force, gravity, tension, normal force)
capabilities.note: Merged from cap-06a–cap-06f (owner decision 2026-11-24). Ours has no switch for any vector: the top view always draws v and a, the vertical circle always draws v, a_c, Fg and T; no inward force or normal force.

capabilities.text: Write your own label on each vector, or leave it off
Put a blank line in place of a vector’s label for students
Split the conical pendulum’s tension into horizontal and vertical components
Mark a radius or a diameter
capabilities.note: Ours draws an unlabeled dashed centre line under the acceleration; no radius/diameter mark.

capabilities.text: Mark the angular speed ω
capabilities.note: Ours prints the angular speed in the answer text, not as a mark on the figure.

capabilities.text: Mark the angle of the first position
Letter the positions A, B, C…
Draw the object as a ball or a block
Give the object its own label
Write vectors with an arrow over each label, or in bold
Color the figure for slides, or black and white
